run and revive write none), passing the trust-record row only when the record was written, Run A showed the trust modal and Run F's start shows no modal and the input box; no key into any dialog — the probe hook answers C and D's) against the CLI (default `claude`), check the relied ledger rows (`LedgerRow::relied()`: all twenty-three, on every build), print `[NN/MM]` step lines (`MM` the relied count, 23; a run stopped by Ctrl-C or TERM kills its child with no key, removes only the probe dirs it created and its own trust record from the Claude config file, writes no stamp, leaves stdout empty, prints `unable: verify was stopped before it finished` / `hint: run viola verify again to stamp this CLI` and exits 1 (SIGKILL, a crash or a failed handler install leaves the dirs to remove by hand). `--record <dir>` also writes the scrubbed `<dir>/<ver>/<Event>.default.json` fixtures, the `<Event>.<stem>-<n>.json` dialog variants, Run B's `paste-<n>` / `compact-<n>` / `clear-<n>` framing variants, Run E's first SessionStart as `SessionStart.resume-1.json`, Run B's agents read as `Agents.recorded-1.json` (Run B's own row only) and signature-only `Screen.<phase>.json` screens (a footer or modal row whole, the input box's rule row as its rule chars alone and its prompt row as the prompt char alone, every other row empty; a box whose live prompt row holds a home path, the username or an email refuses the recording) when 0 rows fail; an unclean recording is refused naming the file and check code. Run it from a folder you trust in Claude Code whose external CLAUDE.md import is answered. Against the real CLI: local only, spends tokens; CI runs it only against the fake agent's `-p/--print` mode and its `--screens --turn-stop --trusted-root --dialogs --framing --transcript --trust-config` interactive modes, under a test-owned user home whose config file is seeded empty and owner-only and named to the fake agent by `--trust-config` (every stamping verify passes `--transcript` beside `--framing`, or Run B's echo probe is skipped and the local-command-echo row fails). The `Mcp.<variant>.json` MCP exchanges are recorded not by `--record` but by the test-only `viola-mcp-tap` (`record` / `fixture`, the same scrub and closed refusal codes; architecture §Occupied Resources → Binary); the recorded Hyprland replies likewise by the test-only `viola-hypr-tap`, under the same scrub

body:
Added the 23rd relied ledger row, trust-record: viola verify writes a trust record for its own temp dir into the claude config file its child reads, starts a sixth interactive run (Run F, after Run E) and checks that the child opens with no trust modal, then removes only that record (also on a stop, through a guard).
The row's stamp value is pass, fail or the writer's closed code word when nothing was written (14 words: written, removed, config-absent, config-unreadable, config-link, config-not-regular, config-foreign, config-oversize, config-malformed, config-dir-unusable, home-unknown, key-present, lock-held, lost); the stamps gain measured.trust_probe with write and remove; no log event or field was added.
verify now reads one environment value, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, only when the strip keeps that name, else the user home; the writer takes a private lock, retries up to 3 attempts, bounds every read at MAX_FRAME and keeps the file's own mode.
Counts moved: relied rows 22 to 23, verify step counter [NN/23], summary 23 pass 0 fail, verify interactive runs five to six (A to F), verify spawn pairs eight to nine, fake-agent starts per verify six to seven.
The fake agent learned a test-only --trust-config read and a --trust-record-blank hold; every test-started verify now runs under a test-owned user home (a --record start keeps the real HOME and a kept CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), held by a new census test; the live rig gained a v arm.
One live S0 on claude 2.1.325 read trust-record fail (7 of 23 pass, confounded): recorded as read, the row stays proven on the fake agent and unverified on the real CLI.

The session added the 23rd relied ledger row, trust-record: viola verify writes a trust record for its own fresh temp folder into the claude config its child reads, runs a sixth interactive run (Run F) there, checks the folder opens with no trust modal, then removes that one record.
